findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects such as the referenced vendor roster may therefore be stored without a bucket-enforced encryption requirement.
The bucket is configured with a private ACL but no default server-side encryption configuration, so stored ledger exports are not protected by a bucket-enforced encryption requirement.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not encrypt stored model artifacts.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving runbook objects without a bucket-enforced encryption requirement at rest.

The uploaded vendor-roster.xlsx object does not specify server-side encryption and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. This object can therefore be stored unencrypted at rest.
